what: /  Menu button with three 4px dots spaced 8px apart inside a 42px round border — on hover the dots blink once in .05s sequence (down to .2 opacity, .4s linear), and on press (aria-expanded=true) the dot group immediately rotates 180° and shrinks by half, the end dots grow into 40×10px bars at .4s after a .3s delay to form an X, and the center dot disappears. On close the bars shrink back to dots in .3s and slide into place after .3s

options.toggle: if none, pressing does not change aria-expanded (for when the consumer changes it together with the drawer)

note: Color is currentColor (default --kf-ink) — on a dark drawer, the side using it changes color. The original bar is 4rem×1rem on a 10px root font size, so it is written as 40×10px. Size is --fx-size

from.where: shared.css .sr-dots · shared.js (original .l-meatballsMenu — at the right end of the header row, opens the full menu drawer when pressed)
